Specification: This module specifies and proves correctness of a PlusCal encoding of the Boulangerie algorithm, a variant of Lamport's bakery-style mutual exclusion algorithm due to Moses and Patkin. It models the translated per-process control-location actions, proves type correctness and mutual exclusion with TLAPS, and states liveness properties for deadlock freedom and starvation freedom under weak fairness.
